title: Production Document-Processing Agent Components

nodes.label: Document Intake Gateway
nodes.description: Accept authenticated document submissions, enforce request shape and size limits, attach source key and receipt timestamp, and route each request to idempotent ingestion.

nodes.label: External Document Sources
nodes.description: Provide read-only inbound documents and metadata through upload, scan, or batch channels; these sources are inputs and are not mutated by this system.

nodes.label: Idempotent Ingestion Service
nodes.description: Resolve source key plus content fingerprint, suppress duplicates, create or reuse a document session, and emit exactly one accepted-ingestion outcome per logical document.

nodes.label: Raw Document Store
nodes.description: Persist immutable original documents, content fingerprints, ingestion receipts, and retention state so prior artifacts can be retrieved for reprocessing or audit.

nodes.label: Document Metadata Ledger
nodes.description: Own canonical document state, versions, ownership tags, processing attempts, confidence summaries, and current status transitions from intake to final or quarantined.

nodes.label: Processing Work Queue
nodes.description: Buffer accepted work items with attempt count, visibility timeout, priority class, and idempotency token so processing survives restarts and traffic spikes.

nodes.label: Retry and Dead-Letter Controller
nodes.description: Classify transient versus terminal failures, apply bounded backoff, cancel stale attempts, isolate poison documents to dead-letter state, and preserve retry evidence.

nodes.label: Agent Orchestration Controller
nodes.description: Coordinate parsing, extraction, enrichment, validation, review, finalize, and rollback steps as resumable workflow state without embedding business rules in transport.

nodes.label: Document Parsing Service
nodes.description: Convert accepted files into normalized pages, text spans, tables, images, and layout hints while recording parser version and per-page warnings.

nodes.label: Extraction Agent Service
nodes.description: Select allowed tools and prompts, extract typed fields and entities from normalized content, cite evidence spans, and return structured candidates with confidence.

nodes.label: Tool Inventory Policy
nodes.description: Define which retrieval, parsing, calculation, and validation tools the extraction agent may use for each document class, keeping capabilities explicit and bounded.

nodes.label: Reference and Template Store
nodes.description: Store reusable document templates, field dictionaries, validation examples, and prior approved outputs that extraction may retrieve but not silently overwrite.

nodes.label: Validation and Risk Rules Service
nodes.description: Check schema, business invariants, cross-field consistency, sensitivity markers, and risk thresholds; produce pass, repair, review, or reject outcomes.

nodes.label: Review Routing Decision
nodes.description: Decide auto-finalize, human review, reprocess, or quarantine from confidence, validation outcome, value at risk, and policy thresholds; decision inputs are logged.

nodes.label: Human Review Console
nodes.description: Present queued documents with evidence spans, extracted fields, confidence, and policy reasons so reviewers can approve, correct, reject, or request reprocessing.

nodes.label: Human Review Service
nodes.description: Own review task assignment, locking, decision capture, correction rationale, escalation, and completion events; review decisions are explicit before finalization.

nodes.label: Review Task Store
nodes.description: Persist review queues, assignments, edits, decisions, rationale, timestamps, and reviewer identity for audit and later bounded evaluation reuse.

nodes.label: Finalization Service
nodes.description: Promote approved results to final status only after validation and required human confirmation; writes final output version and closes the workflow idempotently.

nodes.label: Processed Output Store
nodes.description: Persist immutable final and superseded extraction outputs with lineage to raw document, prompt or model versions, validation results, and review decision.

nodes.label: Result Access Service
nodes.description: Serve read-only final results, status, and evidence links to internal consumers; it does not write to downstream business systems.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Service
nodes.description: Append tamper-evident events for intake, retries, tool use, decisions, review actions, finalization, release changes, and rollback with correlation across attempts.

nodes.label: Audit Log Store
nodes.description: Retain immutable audit events, actor and service identity, before and after state references, policy version, and query indexes for investigations and compliance review.

nodes.label: Rollback and Recovery Controller
nodes.description: Restore prior document versions, output versions, or workflow state after processing failures; execute compensating cleanup and prove recovery through audit events.

nodes.label: Feedback Capture Service
nodes.description: Convert reviewer corrections and terminal failures into labeled feedback records linked to raw evidence, outputs, prompts, and rules without changing live behavior directly.

nodes.label: Evaluation Dataset Store
nodes.description: Curate golden samples, regression sets, failure-mode cases, and reviewer-labeled corrections for repeatable offline and pre-release evaluation.

nodes.label: Evaluation and Gate Service
nodes.description: Run regression and failure-mode checks on candidate prompts, models, parsers, and rules; compare against acceptance thresholds and block unsafe promotion.

nodes.label: Prompt and Model Registry
nodes.description: Version prompts, models, parsers, tool policies, and rules with lineage, evaluation results, approval state, and rollback target.

nodes.label: Release Rollout Controller
nodes.description: Promote approved prompt, model, ranking, parser, or live configuration versions through guarded rollout, monitor impact, and revert to prior versions when gates fail.

nodes.label: Observability and SLO Service
nodes.description: Expose metrics, traces, queue depth, retry burn, review backlog, accuracy proxies, latency, cost, drift signals, and alerts tied to recovery runbooks.

nodes.label: Operational Runbook Console
nodes.description: Let operators inspect stuck documents, replay eligible failures, approve rollback, drain queues, and verify post-recovery state without bypassing audit capture.

assumptions: Documents arrive from upstream portals, scanners, or batch jobs and are processed inside this system boundary.
No external business system is mutated by the agent; downstream consumers read final outputs through read-only access.
Human review is required before finalizing low-confidence or high-impact documents and before costly reprocessing.
Reviewer corrections can enter bounded evaluation and prompt or model release only after regression gates and approval.
Duplicate submissions are expected; ingestion must be idempotent by source key plus content fingerprint.
Failures must be retry-safe, observable, recoverable, and explainable through immutable audit records.
Rollback covers document versions, extraction outputs, validation results, prompt or model versions, and workflow state.
Model, prompt, ranking, and parser assets are versioned and separable from document data.
